item.title: How busy families can stay healthy throughout the school year
item.description: By the time the school year settles into its rhythm, most families are juggling packed calendars, long to-do lists, and very little downtime. When schedules feel nonstop, healthy routines can slip without anyone noticing. A few steady habits can help everyone stay on track.

item.title: GLP-1 drugs are great weight-loss tools. But they work best with lifestyle changes, experts say
item.description: GLP-1 weight-loss drugs are a positive development, but they do not eliminate the need for lifestyle modifications like diet and exercise, experts say. Making a permanent dent in Americans' weight crisis will take a combination of strategies.

item.title: A Renaissance-style street fair is coming to South Street this spring
item.description: A stretch of South Street will take on a fantasy theme this spring as Queen & Rook hosts its annual Fantasy Faire Block Party on Saturday, May 2.

item.title: Drink the Delaware festival debuts at Independence Seaport Museum this spring
item.description: The Independence Seaport Museum will debut Drink the Delaware, a waterfront tasting event combining craft beverage sampling with environmental education, on Saturday, March 28 from 4-9 p.m.

item.title: Taylor Swift's 'The Life of a Showgirl' was the best-selling album worldwide in 2025
item.description: Pop stars Taylor Swift and Sabrina Carpenter had some of the best-selling albums worldwide in 2025, the IFPI says. Swift's 'Life of a Showgirl' was the top album. Carpenter's 'Man's Best Friend' and 'Short n' Sweet' also fared well.

item.title: Intermittent fasting is unlikely to cause greater weight loss than traditional dieting, study finds
item.description: Intermittent fasting has been touted as a weight-loss approach by social media influencers, but new research suggests it is unlikely to lead to greater weight-loss than traditional dieting methods.

item.title: Joel Embiid out for Sixers-Pelicans on Saturday in front end of back-to-back
item.description: Joel Embiid went over a month without having an unplanned absence. He has missed three games in a row since.

item.title: Willow Grove man will serve 2 years in prison for insider trading
item.description: Carlos Sacanell, 59, of Willow Grove will serve two years in prison for buying stock in Oak Street Health based on insider information from his girlfriend, an executive at the company. CVS acquired the primary care network in 2023.

item.title: Maritime museum at Jersey Shore heavily damaged by burst pipe
item.description: The New Jersey Maritime Museum, which houses artifacts from shipwrecks and other historical relics, suffered extensive damage last week after a pipe burst at the Beach Haven property.

item.title: Here's how to spot Easter eggs that Isaiah Zagar hid in many of his mosaics
item.description: Isaiah Zagar, who died Thursday at the age of 86, frequently hid himself, his wife, pets, motto and artists he admired in his mixed-media mosaics across South Philly. Here's how to spot the Easter eggs.
